Contract ManageStoreCRUDService::createStore(id: Integer,name: String,address: String,isopened: Boolean): Boolean {
	definition:
		store: Store = Store.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id),
		isExist: Boolean = store.oclIsUndefined()
	precondition:
		store.oclIsUndefined() = isExist
	postcondition:
		if isExist 
		then let store: Store in
		store.oclIsNew() and
		Store.allInstance()->includes(store) and
		store.Id = id and
		store.Name = name and
		store.Address = address and
		store.IsOpened = isopened and
		result = true 
		else result = false 
		endif 
}
